issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): plugins_browser split imports 4 private helpers across new modules
issue.description:
`just _lint-symvision` fails on a clean tree:

```
Error: Private functions/classes should not be imported. Make these public if they need to be imported by non-test files!:
  _CombinedInstallOutcome in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plugins_browser_install_previews.py
  _combined_install_message in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plugins_browser_install_messages.py
  _install_many_skipped_message in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plugins_browser_install_messages.py
  _source_variant_label in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plugins_browser_install_messages.py
```

HEAD (`ebbfbc91b`) is itself "refactor(tui): split
plugins_browser_install into focused modules under 500 lines", so the
split very likely left these private helpers imported across the new
modules -- the same pattern as sase-13l, sase-10n, and sase-zk. Observed
while verifying an unrelated Beads navigation split; that change touches
only `beads_navigation*.py` and one Beads test file, and its own modules
produce no symvision errors.

---

## CI failure

- **Node:** `just _lint-symvision::plugins_browser private-import`

Deterministic static lint failure, not a flake: reproduced on the clean
tree via `git stash -u` (baseline `just _lint-symvision` exits 1 with
byte-identical error lines), then restored with `git stash pop`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static lint failure reproduced on the clean tree via git stash (byte-identical errors); unrelated Beads split adds no symvision errors.
